_meta.label: SYNTHETIC - NOT ADIC DATA. Illustrative parameters for the slimmed five-component prototype. Not ADIC data and not a forecast.
_meta.spec: design/DECISION_SPACE_AND_GOAL_OBJECTIVE.md v1.1 (DSGO), as revised by examples/mpo_v2/spec_review.md; design/SLIM_ARCHITECTURE.md (SLIM)
_meta.how_to_change: Every number the program uses is a 'value' in this file. Edit and re-run mpo_v2.py. The run lists any parameter the code never read (results.json checks.params_unused) and any entry missing a unit, rationale or source.
_meta.units: Money in $bn; rates and returns are annual decimals unless the key ends in _q (quarterly) or _pp (percentage points a year).
_meta.source_tags: SYN = research/00_SYNTHESIS.md; GRP = research/groups/01_GROUPS_SYNTHESIS.md; RA = research/groups/02_REAL_ASSETS_SYNTHESIS.md; LIT = research/literature/00_LITERATURE_SYNTHESIS.md; ARCH = design/ARCHITECTURE.md; DSGO = design/DECISION_SPACE_AND_GOAL_OBJECTIVE.md; TD = examples/tree_demo; [A] = working assumption of this prototype, owned and swept; [I] = derived in this prototype.

sofr.rationale: Cash, IG and posted margin earn SOFR; base rate of every floating loan.

rate.rationale: 10% nominal USD time-weighted return, gross of distributions.

years.rationale: Decision horizon of the goal; the 10-year horizon is a sensitivity not run in this prototype.

W0_reported.rationale: Reported NAV today (allocation v2). The goal is measured on economic NAV, so W0 for the goal ratio is the economic NAV computed from the book.

eps_g.rationale: Margin above the goal wealth that the MILP requires for a leaf to count as a success; stops knife-edge successes.

inflation.rationale: Deflator for the CRRA comparison's real wealth.

c_max_factor.rationale: Cap on the GBO buffer: c_max = 2 W*/W0 (about 3.2 at 5 years), above the largest optimal buffer in the lognormal check.

names.rationale: The three CMA worlds the prototype pools (J.P. Morgan 2027; BlackRock fee-adjusted; BlackRock risk premia rise).

eq_log_excess.unit: per year, log excess of SOFR
eq_log_excess.rationale: World equity premia, calibrated so the status-quo book's expected 5-year geometric return is near the bridge's evidence-central 8.8% (M1), 10.5% (M2) and 6.1% (M6); pooled near 8.5%.
eq_log_excess.source: SYN section 4.12 bridge table; calibration in this prototype [I]

credit_drift.unit: per year added to the credit excess return
credit_drift.rationale: M2 slightly richer credit carry; M6 reprices credit (risk premia rise).

P_q.unit: quarterly transition matrix over [expansion, late_cycle, crisis, recovery]
P_q.rationale: Crisis persistence 0.70 a quarter gives a mean dwell of 10 months (inside 6-18); P(stress within 12 months from calm) is about 17% including the oil coupling (inside 13-35%).
P_q.source: SYN section 4.1 (dwell 6-18 months; P(stress within 12 months) 13-35%)

start.rationale: Market regime reads calm (>= 0.99) in October 2026.

P_q.unit: quarterly transition matrix over [open, normal, drought, frozen]
P_q.rationale: Quarterly persistence 0.85 / 0.88 / 0.88 / 0.75; drought persists with probability about 0.60 after 12 months.
P_q.source: SYN section 4.2 exit-window table; section 4.1 (drought 0.87, 0.61 after 12 months)

crisis_push_q.rationale: In a macro crisis quarter the exit window moves one step worse with this probability (crisis -> frozen exits).

P_q.unit: quarterly transition matrix over [normal, boom, glut, demand_bust, supply_shock, gulf_war]
P_q.rationale: Gulf-war state decays (about 20% of 2027 in the war state, against the IMF's 17%), with a post-war glut channel; normal is about 60% of steady-state time and demand bust 2-6%.
P_q.source: SYN section 4.1 (shock-type shares N 0.55-0.65, DB 0.02-0.06; IMF 17%); RA section 9.3

crisis_given_demand_bust_q.rationale: A demand bust pushes the macro regime into crisis (P(crisis | DB) >= 0.8).

crisis_given_glut_q.rationale: A glut raises crisis odds modestly (P(crisis | glut) about 0.15 over a glut spell).

regime_shift_q.unit: quarterly log return shift by regime entered
regime_shift_q.rationale: Shape of the quarter by regime; centred on its expectation given the regime left, so the expected return is the same from every regime (nothing to time).

vol_annual.rationale: Calm, late-cycle, crisis and recovery equity volatility.

level.rationale: Spread levels for a direct-lending / high-yield index by regime.

start.rationale: Tight spreads in a calm October 2026 market.

kappa_q.rationale: Mean reversion of the spread toward its regime level.

vol_q.unit: quarterly spread shock sd by regime

duration.rationale: Spread duration of the credit index.

crisis_shift_q.rationale: Flight to quality lowers yields in a crisis.

level.rationale: Mean-reversion targets by oil-shock type; long-run 70.

kappa_q.rationale: Mean reversion of log Brent toward the shock-type level; reproduces a backwardated strip from today's spot.
kappa_q.source: SYN section 4.1 (start from the futures strip) [A]

vol_q.unit: quarterly log shock sd by shock type

level.unit: exit factor level by exit window
level.rationale: Exit factor X: open +1, normal 0, drought -1, frozen -2.

phi_q.rationale: Persistence of the exit factor around its window level.

level.rationale: Implied-volatility level by regime (RV-20 adds implied vol as a driver).

kappa_q.rationale: Mean reversion to the regime level.

spot_down.unit: VIX points per 1% fall in the quarter's equity return
spot_down.rationale: Spot-vol response (quarterly analogue of s- = -1.35 daily).

corr_normal.unit: correlation of shocks [equity, spread, yield, oil, exit] outside crisis
corr_normal.rationale: Spreads widen and exits shut when equities fall.

corr_crisis.unit: correlation of shocks in crisis quarters
corr_crisis.rationale: Correlations rise in a crisis; yields fall with equities (flight to quality); oil falls with equities (demand bust).

prior_rate.rationale: Last year's rate; with smoothing 0.5 and today's high Brent it gives a 2027 draw of 5.75%, about $10.2bn (research: $9.9-10.8bn).

kink_high.rationale: Draw target at the 5% floor above about $67 Brent.

kink_low.rationale: Draw target at the 10% cap below about $23 Brent.

override_prob.unit: probability a year by shock type
override_prob.rationale: Owner override of the rule: 0.25% (N, B, SS), 1% (SG, DB), 2% (GW).

exit_dist_mult.unit: multiplier on distribution intensity by exit window

exit_call_mult.unit: multiplier on call intensity by exit window

crisis_call_stress.unit: multiplier on calls in crisis quarters
crisis_call_stress.source: DSGO section 4.6 H4 (calls x1.29); SYN section 2.3

kappa_theta_q.rationale: Pull of reported NAV toward economic NAV (marks catch up as assets exit); with smoothing phi it gives the path-dependent theta = V/N of DSGO section 5.1.

str_draw_threshold.rationale: A glut or demand-bust node is STR when next year's draw is at least 8%.

n_factor_mean_paths.rationale: Paths used to compute the 5-year average expected factor returns that translate beliefs into alphas.

branches.rationale: Rank rule (children >= matched drivers + 1): 10 children match 7 drivers at stage 1 (6 factors + belief error), 7 children match 6 factors at stage 2. DSGO's 10 x 8 x 8 = 640 leaves does not fit the 15-minute budget; the computed task asks for about 200 leaves.
branches.source: DSGO section 5.2 rank rule (RV-06); computed task (about 200 leaves)

fan_paths.rationale: One medoid path per tercile of the status-quo 3-year return, moment-matched on that return: 10 x 7 x 3 = 210 leaves.

n_stage1_paths.rationale: One-year paths simulated from today for the stage-1 clustering.

n_stage2_paths.rationale: Continuations clustered into the stage-2 children.

n_fan_candidates.rationale: Three-year candidate paths from which the tercile medoids are chosen.

stage1_strata.rationale: Stage 1 is stratified by shock type: at least one demand-bust STR branch, one other STR branch and a Gulf-war continuation, because the three call on liquidity differently. Strata with too few paths merge into a neighbour.
stage1_strata.source: DSGO section 5.1 start-state stratification; SYN L3

min_stratum_paths.rationale: A stratum with fewer simulated paths than this (or than its branch count) is merged into its neighbour.

stage2_min_class_mass.rationale: A node class with at least this conditional mass gets its own stage-2 branch; paths of rarer classes join the nearest cluster, so no probability mass is dropped.

belief_error_fan_scale.unit: multiplier on sigma_post x e in each fan year
belief_error_fan_scale.rationale: The belief-error driver is drawn at the fan branching (so no decision node can condition on it) and acts in the three fan years; scaling by 5/3 gives it the 5-year log-wealth impact of a 5-year alpha error. Drawn at stage 1 (DSGO section 3.3) it was a look-ahead leak: stage-1 decisions traded on it in the tree while the executed playbook could not see it.

stage2_recourse_only.rationale: With three fan paths per stage-2 node, discretionary stage-2 trades are fitted to three outcomes; stage-2 nodes keep funding moves, forced deleveraging and the stage-1 pacing and overlay (like the fans). Year-1 contingent plans (stage 1) remain fully discretionary.
stage2_recourse_only.source: DSGO sections 5.2-5.3 deviation, measured in the out-of-sample diagnostics [I]

book.rationale: Headline synthetic book (holdings marks, bids and sealed truth).

factor_means.rationale: Paths for the expected factor returns that turn beliefs into alphas.

select.rationale: Selection path set (best simple rule, tie-breaks); disjoint from certification.

cert.rationale: Certification path set: every reported out-of-sample number.

replication_books.rationale: Extra synthetic books (truth-model variants) for the replication check; the placebo book uses the headline seed with true alpha independent of the marks.
replication_books.source: DSGO RV-02 (K books; scaled down for the time budget)

cash0.rationale: Corporate Finance / Treasury cash and money-market holdings at t0 (177 reported NAV minus the 162 held across the eight groups). Posted margin is paid out of it at the root.
cash0.source: SYN section 2.2 holder table (Corporate Finance / Treasury 15)

fi_liquidity_weight.rationale: Investment-grade fixed income (LO-04) counts toward IG + cash at 98% of value.
fi_liquidity_weight.source: SYN section 2.3(d) canonical IG + cash [A haircut]

beta_sq.rationale: Synthetic equity beta the Overlay runs at t0; the status quo keeps it in dollars.
beta_sq.source: SYN section 2.2 (Overlay supplies synthetic beta, $10bn at t0); section 2.3(d)

im_rate.unit: initial margin per $ notional by class [BEN, DRT, STR]
im_rate.rationale: Futures IM rising from 4% to 10% in stress.

beta_fin_spread.unit: per year over SOFR by class
beta_fin_spread.rationale: Embedded financing of synthetic beta: 30bp average, 81bp at the June-2026 roll, 175bp in stress.

p2s_fin_spread.unit: per year per $ notional by class
p2s_fin_spread.rationale: Cost of physical-to-synthetic per $ freed: 0.40-0.70% normal, 0.80-1.11% (June 2026), 2.2-3.3% stress.

p2s_cap.rationale: P2S capacity on the DM core sleeve.

trs_cap_share.unit: share of the hedge-fund lot's NAV
trs_cap_share.rationale: TRS notional per lot is capped at half the lot (counterparty capacity).

gross_max.rationale: Gross overlay (synthetic beta + P2S + TRS notional) cap.

tail_strike_lo.rationale: Upper strike of the put spread (90).

tail_rung_factor.rationale: Scales the annual put-spread payoff so a crash pays 0.166 per $ notional (0.166 / 0.18).

tail_budget.unit: premium as share of NAV per year [floor, cap]
tail_budget.rationale: Tail budget 0.15-0.50% of NAV; the status quo sits at the floor ($7.1bn notional).

opp_vol_per_im.unit: annual P&L sd per $ of IM
opp_vol_per_im.rationale: Vol 1.0% of NAV at $1bn of IM (1.0-1.5% in the research; low end).

opp_load_eq.unit: loading on the standardized equity surprise

opp_load_vol.unit: loading on the standardized implied-vol surprise
opp_load_vol.rationale: Short-volatility carry: loses when implied vol jumps (RV-20).

opp_idio_share.rationale: Idiosyncratic share of the opportunistic book's P&L variance: in the simulator only (the tree carries the factor part).

eq_vol_ref.rationale: Standardizes the equity surprise for the opportunistic book.

vix_vol_ref.unit: annual sd of the vol factor

consent_scenario.rationale: R1: a committed revolver is signed and every policy (baselines included) can use it before any red sale (facility parity).

revolver_upsize_max.rationale: FUND can upsize to $15bn, effective from stage 1 (2-quarter lead).

revolver_undrawn_fee.rationale: Undrawn fee, paid by every policy under parity.

revolver_avail.unit: share of capacity drawable by class

term_avail.rationale: Facilities signed in stress count zero.

recourse_cap.rationale: Recourse debt cap (hard; 0.10 reported as target).

navf.unit: LTV / spread over SOFR by class; OID; pool cap as share of private NAV; availability
navf.rationale: LP-portfolio NAV facility (Corporate Finance): 10% LTV (5% stressed) on a pledge pool <= 20% of private NAV, SOFR + 300bp (+140bp stress), PIK, forced paydown when the LTV cap tightens.

pref.unit: advance as share of pool NAV; accrual rate by class; fee; availability
pref.rationale: LP-portfolio preferred equity: cash 20-35% of pool NAV, 12% preferred return (14% in stress), accruing; deducted at the leaf with accruals.

csbl.unit: max debt / book value; spread; availability
csbl.rationale: Capital Solutions back-leverage at D/E <= 0.5, bank SOFR + 300bp, arranged in BEN only.

smabl.rationale: SMA back-leverage, LTV <= 40-45%, SOFR + 200-275bp, BEN with lender lead time.

raco.unit: $bn capacity; portfolio LTV; spread by class; availability
raco.rationale: Real-asset cash-out refinancing at maturity (controlled assets only): capacity $0.53-0.90bn, portfolio LTV <= 55%, spreads 3.2 / 4.4 / 7.2% over SOFR.

SEC_BUY.rationale: Contingent discount purchase of LP interests at price rho x theta per $ of reported NAV (rho = buyer residual on economic NAV by class), gated on a discount > 20% and stage not Black; group NAV <= 10% of the fund; winner's-curse haircut 4.5%.

CO_DEAL.rationale: New co-investments, $0.6-1.2bn a year, paused in Amber or worse.

CS_NEW.rationale: Capital Solutions new money, <= $1.2bn a year; rescue deals in stress earn more (15-20% gross).

PC_NEW.rationale: New senior loans: unitranche S+525 normal, +525-600 tight, +700-900 in a crisis (excess spread entered as alpha).

INFRA_LEV.rationale: Contracted-infrastructure add-on with acquisition debt at SOFR + 200bp, 50% LTV (debt 1.0 per $ equity), BEN only; asset alpha 0.25pp prior + 0.4pp after charges.

SMA_LEV.rationale: Levered SMA sleeve, D/E 1.0 at SOFR + 225bp, senior non-software loans, BEN only.

plan.rationale: Commitment plan in allocation v2: PE $3.5bn (v1.1's $5.34bn x 34/52); RA infrastructure-led $1.2bn; Secondaries, Private Credit and Capital Solutions from the 60/10/10/10/10 split scaled to v2.
plan.source: DSGO section 2.1 (PE plan $3.5bn); RA section 2.3 ($1.2bn); SYN section 2.3 (split) [A]

segments.rationale: Flow profile of a new commitment (calls by age, distributions, loadings).

mult_range.rationale: Commitment budget range with the protected 25% core; the stage ranges (Green 0.75-1.25x, Amber 0.25-0.5x) are reported, not imposed, so the plan is not driven by a hard IC range (TD verify_finance H3).

c_pace.unit: $ per $ of commitment above (+) or below (-) plan, at the leaf
c_pace.rationale: Post-horizon part of the alpha of commitments made or forgone, counted once at the leaf (8.6 cents per PE $).

tc.rationale: Impact + half-spread: 4-13bp US large cap, 23-40bp EM; hedge-fund subscriptions at NAV.

k_sel.unit: share of W0 per unit per node at the median posterior sd
k_sel.rationale: Per-unit trade cap |dv_i| <= k_sel W0 sigma_ref / sigma_post,i: units with weaker evidence trade in smaller size (belief risk).

xmax_liquid.rationale: Upper bound on a liquid holding (other rows bind first).

lp_depth_year.unit: $bn of PE + Secondaries LP sales per year by class
lp_depth_year.rationale: <= 5% of segment depth per half-year (secondary volume about $230bn a year) times the success probability 0.80 / 0.60 / 0.45.

co_sale_share.unit: share of group NAV per year

ra_sale_share.unit: share of RA NAV per year by class

amber_sale_share.unit: share of group NAV per year by class
amber_sale_share.rationale: Syndication / loan-sale depth; thin in STR.

hf_secondary_share.unit: share of HF NAV per year

redeem_phi.unit: share of a redemption paid within 12 months by class
redeem_phi.rationale: Hedge funds: P5 66% by 12 months in a crisis; open-end real estate 34% by month 12 (14% under stress).
redeem_phi.source: DSGO sections 2.6-2.7; GRP section 3.5; RA section 4.6

floor_hard.rationale: Hard floor at every node, fan year and leaf.

floor_target.rationale: 8% at BEN and DRT nodes (except the first node after a STR node); hard, with its dual as the price.

behind_cap_share.rationale: At behind nodes the cap is 1 + 0.5 (L_class - 1).

kappa_c.unit: $ of borrowed exposure per $ of B0 cushion
kappa_c.rationale: Borrowed exposure <= kappa_c x the status quo's non-red liquidity cushion (exogenous).

behind_gap.rationale: A node is behind if the status quo's cumulative TWR trails the 10% path by more than 2pp.

range_band.rationale: No charge inside 0.5-1.5x the group's SAA (t0) weight.

range_charge.unit: per $ of breach per decision year
range_charge.rationale: Elastic, priced IC ranges; waived at STR nodes.

red_eps_tree.rationale: Tree buffer of the red-event CVaR surrogate (tighter than the certified 1%).

red_sale_threshold.rationale: A red-tier sale above this size at a non-Green node (or a fire-sale bid) is a red event in the CVaR row.

red_bid_ratio.rationale: ADR-39: a red-tier sale below 0.9 x the normal bid is a red event.

stage_cash_bands.unit: IG + cash / W thresholds Green / Amber / Red
stage_cash_bands.rationale: CFP event bands: Green >= 8%, Amber 6-8%, Red 4-6%, Black < 4%; class adds DRT -> Amber, STR -> Red.
stage_cash_bands.source: ARCH CFP indicators; TD verify_finance H6

margin_lo_haircut.rationale: Long-only equity counts at (1 - 35.8%) in the 12-month non-red capacity.

margin_hf_phi.rationale: Hedge-fund pass-through within 12 months in stress (P5).

margin_amber_share.rationale: Amber (CS + PC) saleable within 12 months in stress at stressed bids.

margin_vm_drop.rationale: Variation margin on futures notional in the stressed year.

h4.rationale: T4' at the root: equity -35.8%, distributions 0.189 x drought, calls x1.29, draws 10% for 2 years, revolver 50%, NAV facility at 5% LTV, hedge funds at 0.83.

depth_levels.rationale: Multi-level relative depth guard against the status quo's leaf distribution.

depth_delta.rationale: delta = 0 for the recommendation (approximately SSD at three levels).

psi_unfunded.unit: $ per $ of unfunded at the leaf
psi_unfunded.rationale: Burden of unfunded commitments at the horizon.

crra_gamma.rationale: CRRA comparison and the mandatory GBO tie-break.

crra_tangents.rationale: Piecewise-linear outer approximation of the CRRA utility (DSGO uses 48 adaptive tangents; 32 geometric tangents on [0.25, 4] keep the approximation error below 0.2% of utility in the relevant range and cut 3,400 rows).

lambda_T.rationale: Quadratic shortfall weight in the CRRA comparison.

l2_segments.rationale: Secant approximation of the squared shortfall on [0, 1].

tiebreak_tol.unit: STRETCH: share of c_max W0 of mean wealth; PLAN: bPOE
tiebreak_tol.rationale: Hold the goal value within this tolerance, then maximize CRRA(3).

milp_time_limit.rationale: Safety time limit of the main MILP; the node limit below binds first, so results are deterministic. DSGO allows 1,800 s and expects 30-90 minutes to optimality at full scale; a prototype run shows the root alone needs minutes, so the MILP is reported with its gap.

milp_node_limit.rationale: Deterministic work limit: root processing only (IPM relaxation, cuts, root heuristics including the sub-MIP), then stop with the incumbent and the root bound.

milp_frontier_time_limit.rationale: Safety time limit of each frontier MILP (the node limit binds first).

milp_frontier_node_limit.rationale: Frontier MILPs run the root relaxation and cuts (a valid upper bound on max P(goal)) from the GBO start; the expensive sub-MIP heuristics are off.

milp_method.rationale: The exact MILP (HiGHS branch and bound with an IPM root) did not leave the root node within the budget (frontier MILPs hit a 400 s safety limit inside the root cut loop; a single uncontended 240 s run reached a 69% gap). 'round' reports a valid upper bound (the MILP relaxation) and a deterministic incumbent from LP rounding of that relaxation; 'highs' runs branch and bound.

milp_heuristic_effort.rationale: Main MILP heuristic effort (root sub-MIP / RINS improve the incumbent; measured +1.3pp of in-tree P(goal) in a 240 s test).

feas_tol.rationale: HiGHS primal and dual feasibility tolerance.

n_cert.rationale: Fresh certification paths (pooled worlds), common random numbers across policies.

n_select.rationale: Selection paths (choose the best simple rule) on their own seed.

chunk.rationale: Paths per certification batch (one batch per worker; 10,000 paths = 8 batches run in parallel).

idio.rationale: Idiosyncratic outcome noise per holding in the simulator (sigma_idio of the segment), absent from the tree.

b0_penalties.rationale: Encodes the status-quo waterfall in the tree: Treasury, long-only, hedge funds, revolver, amber, red; revolver balances are repaid when cash allows.

b3_vix_F.rationale: Maps implied vol to the v8 stress indicator F_t (VIX 16 -> F 0.10 today).

b3_F_band.rationale: Exposure up to 1.30x when F < 0.17, down to 1.0x when F >= 0.34, linear between.

b4_scales.rationale: Risk-matched line: status quo plus synthetic beta financed at SOFR + f (a measurement device that may exceed H5).

eps_grid.rationale: At least five points of max P(goal) and min bPOE against the red-event limit.

milp_points.rationale: Frontier points that also run the max-P(goal) comparison (the 0.6% point is the main MILP); the remaining points reuse it when their GBO solution is identical.

delta_grid.rationale: Depth-guard frontier points beyond delta = 0 (GBO only).

n_forced.rationale: Root actions with the largest goal value get a forced re-solve and an out-of-sample delta (the rest show LP readings only).

n_red_cards.rationale: Red-tier root SELL candidates shown by forced re-solve (ADR-39, Amber today).

rho.unit: bid per $ of ECONOMIC value by node class [BEN, DRT, STR]; the bid per $ of reported NAV is rho x theta
rho.rationale: One price primitive: buyers price economic NAV (rho about 1 at BEN for fund interests, 0.80-0.84 crisis residual at STR); co-investment bids embed a 20-25% buyer hurdle; credit sells near par; RE LP interests carry large value costs.
rho.source: DSGO section 2.1-2.7, RV-10; GRP sections 3.1-3.6; RA sections 6.2, 7.3

age_multiplier.unit: multiplier by the unit's age bucket
age_multiplier.rationale: Late-life and tail-end interests sell at a further discount beyond the stale-mark theta.
age_multiplier.source: DSGO section 2.1 (age multipliers 0.99 / 0.96 / 0.88 / 0.79 / 0.70 on lagged NAV; theta carries the staleness here)

alpha_star_pp.unit: pp a year over the factor-implied return
alpha_star_pp.rationale: Evidence-central selection alpha priors by group; hedge funds at zero (Jurek-Stafford).
alpha_star_pp.source: DSGO section 3.1 prior row; SYN section 4.12; LIT section 3.9

unit_prior_sd_pp.rationale: Prior dispersion of a single holding's forward alpha (manager / deal dispersion), wider than the sleeve-level alpha prior.
unit_prior_sd_pp.source: SYN section 4.3 (sigma_k about 5.5% for single buyout deals) [A]

bias_prior_sd_pp.rationale: Uncertainty of the bias priors; the truth model shifts the true bias by +1 of these.

archive_n_eff.rationale: Size of each group's scored quarterly forecast archive (clustered by vintage).

precision_weights_after_n_eff.rationale: Weights are shrunk halfway to equal until the archive reaches n_eff >= 20.

kappa_prior_median.unit: ratio of true to stated 80% width
kappa_prior_median.rationale: Stated ranges are too narrow; prior LN(ln 1.75, 0.25^2), updated on the archive's range coverage.

benktander_t.rationale: Benktander c* = p / (p + t) between the forecast's chain-ladder estimate and the outside-view prior for fund interests.

actual_weight_phi.rationale: Persistence shrinkage of since-inception performance (0.5 for buyout).
actual_weight_phi.source: DSGO section 3.1 (phi_a = 0.5 buyout) [A for other classes]

outcome_noise.rationale: Outcome noise in the predictive variance (15% funds, 30% single deals; credit, real assets and liquid mandates lower).

buyer_required_return.rationale: Buyer's required return y_b in the market-anchor translation (LP buyout 14%, single-asset co-investment 22%).
buyer_required_return.source: DSGO section 3.1 market-anchor row; GRP section 3.4 [A for credit and RA]

buyer_seller_gap_age_edges.rationale: Age edges of the buyer-seller PME gap for fund interests.

buyer_seller_gap_by_age.rationale: pi_b: +24.5pp below age 4 (anchor unused), about 3pp at ages 4-9; the tail-end value folds the 18% tail-end buyer return into the 14% base.
buyer_seller_gap_by_age.source: DSGO section 3.1 (pi_b about 3pp ages 4-9, -0.8pp tail-end; y_b 18% tail-end)

market_anchor_min_age.rationale: The fund market anchor is unused below age 4.

bid_dispersion.rationale: Error scale of the market anchor (bid dispersion / D).

precision_horizon_quarters.rationale: Forecast precision is capped beyond about 8 quarters: precision x min(1, 8/h).

flags.unit: thresholds (years, IRR gap, theta, return gap, years, TVPI)
flags.rationale: Belief-card flags: hockey-stick forecast, stale NAV, market disagreement > 400bp, zombie NAV.

alpha_dispersion_main.rationale: Dispersion of true alpha in the headline book; the replication books use 0.5 and 1.5.

alpha_dispersion_variants.rationale: True alpha dispersion different from the belief model's prior.

bid_info_main.rationale: Bid informativeness in the headline book.

bias_shift_sd.rationale: True group biases sit one prior sd above the bias priors the fusion uses.

drought_forecast_optimism_pp.rationale: Regime component: forecasts are more optimistic in a drought (today).

range_kappa_true.rationale: Stated 80% ranges cover about 44% of outcomes (36-52%).

actual_persistence.unit: share of true alpha in since-inception returns
actual_persistence.rationale: Realized performance reflects true alpha only partly.

forecast_error_sd_pp.unit: pp a year by noise class
forecast_error_sd_pp.source: SYN section 4.3 (forecast error sd 6%; funds lower) [A]

underwritten_case_down_pp.rationale: Down case below base in the underwriting memo.

underwritten_case_up_pp.rationale: Up case above base in the underwriting memo.

bid_alpha_passthrough.unit: share of true alpha deviation priced by buyers per year of duration
bid_alpha_passthrough.rationale: Bids are only partly informative about true alpha.

archive_error_sd_pp.rationale: Spread of scored past forecast errors in the archive.

realized_benchmark_sd_pp.rationale: Vintage dispersion of realized benchmark returns behind since-inception performance.

opp_sr_mean.rationale: True opportunistic-book Sharpe is drawn per book from the prior N(0.3, 0.25^2).

pe_buyout.unit: segment defaults (B = loadings on [eq, cr, rt, oil, ex, vol]; dist/call = annual intensities by age bucket)
pe_buyout.rationale: Buyout fund interest: de-smoothed beta 1.0; drought distribution rate about 9% and calls about 28-31% of unfunded at the book level; stale tail-end marks (theta 0.84).
pe_buyout.source: DSGO section 3.3 (buyout beta 1.0); SYN sections 2.3, 4.2; GRP section 3.2 (tail-end theta 0.78-0.83)

pe_asia.rationale: Asia/EM buyout fund interest; slower distributions.
pe_asia.source: SYN section 4.4 (Asia/EM feature in the hedonic price) [A]

sec_fund.rationale: Two-layer secondary fund: calls 45% a year of the remainder early, faster distributions.
sec_fund.source: DSGO section 2.2 (secondary-fund calls 45% a year); SYN section 4.2

sec_cv.rationale: Continuation-vehicle stake: beta 1.5-1.6, median exit 4.5 years.

co_deal.rationale: Co-investment cohort: levered equity beta beta_A V/E about 1.3; hold +1.5 years in the deal model; single-asset REFINANCE inadmissible.

cs_credit.rationale: Capital Solutions claim: cash 7% of NAV a year; net alpha about 0 once equity risk is priced.
cs_credit.source: SYN section 2.3 (Capital Solutions cash 7%); SYN section 4.3 (Erel-Flanagan-Weisbach)

pc_sma.rationale: SMA senior loans: coupons paid out, principal reinvested (run-off is a SELL at par); LAY about 7-9%.

pc_fund.rationale: Closed-end direct-lending / ABF fund: coupons and amortization (Private Credit cash 10% of NAV a year at the book level).

pc_evergreen.rationale: Evergreen fund: tenders at NAV but prorated (about 38% filled).

pc_bdc.rationale: Listed BDC shares: marked to market, sold at a market discount to NAV in stress.

hf_multi.rationale: Multi-strategy lot: low beta, short-volatility exposure (put-writing-like returns).

hf_macro.rationale: Global macro lot: near-zero beta, slightly long volatility.

lo_dm_core.rationale: Index-like DM equity core: the physical-to-synthetic sleeve.

lo_dm_active.rationale: Active DM equity; net IR about -0.05.

lo_em.rationale: Active EM equity: higher beta, some oil sensitivity, higher impact cost.

lo_fi.rationale: Fixed income (Treasuries and IG): duration 6, a little credit.

ra_core_re_direct.rationale: Controlled core real estate: true beta 0.57 (0.22 observed), income 5%, cash-out REFINANCE allowed at maturity.
ra_core_re_direct.source: DSGO sections 2.7, 3.3 (core RE 0.57 true vs 0.22 observed); RA section 7.3

ra_core_re_fund.rationale: Open-end core RE fund: redemption queue (34% paid by month 12) or a costly LP sale.

ra_va_re_fund.rationale: Value-add RE fund interest: RE LP interests carry large value costs (kappa 31% / 45%).

ra_gcc_re.rationale: GCC real estate: small oil sensitivity (0 today, 0.18 in glut/demand-bust states); capped at 1% of NAV.

ra_infra_direct.rationale: Contracted infrastructure platform: acquisition debt passes at SOFR + 200bp (alpha* about +0.4% after charges).

ra_infra_fund.rationale: Infrastructure core+ fund interest (infra LP kappa 5% / 15%).

ra_enr_fund.rationale: Levered upstream ENR fund: oil elasticity 0.84.
ra_enr_fund.source: DSGO section 3.3 (0.84 levered upstream); RA section 9.3

ra_enr_direct.rationale: Royalties (0.41) and fee midstream (0.13) blended oil elasticity about 0.3.

units.unit: holdings ($bn reported NAV and unfunded; age in years)
units.rationale: Allocation v2 by group (PE 34, Secondaries 14, Co-investment 18, Capital Solutions 8, Private Credit 14 (SMA 40%, closed-end 45%, evergreen 10%, BDC 5%), hedge funds 20, long-only 36 (DM 22, EM 6, FI 8), Real Assets 18 (RE 9.0, infra 6.5, ENR 2.5)); PE unfunded $10.9bn (census v1.1 rescaled to the v2 bucket); Secondaries $3.5bn; Real Assets $3.5bn. 55 holdings plus three overlay positions and Treasury.
units.source: inputs section 1A (allocation v2); DSGO sections 2.1-2.8; CHECKPOINT section 2 (census v1.1 rescaled)
